integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the waist up, dressed so that the inside of the forearm is bare and clearly visible. The camera pushes in at slow speed. The skin of the inside of the forearm begins to bulge outward from inside, slowly, as if something behind it were leaning against a sheet of rubber. The bulge sharpens into an open hand, and the skin stretches thin and glossy over it, following every contour exactly while staying intact. <Subject 1> holds completely still and looks down at it. The shape presses harder; the skin around it pulls taut in fine radiating creases, then relaxes a little as the pressure eases, and presses again, patient and deliberate. <Subject 1> lifts one trembling hand toward it but stops a few centimetres away. In the final moment the shape withdraws and the skin settles smooth, then a second shape presses out right beside it.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, shallow breathing, the soft squeak of stretched skin, and a slow deep pressure sound from inside the body.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
